| description = Located at points #5 and #6 on the 2nd floor of Dalnir, with other goo variants as placeholders and a 12 minute respawn time. There are two separate spawns referred to as "Thorny Goo" and "Carpet Goo", each with its own loot table. 

'''"Thorny Goo"''' is located in the hole in the wall. He gets his name from the proc effect on the Two Handed Practice Sword he drops, which he will proc on himself if he is going to drop it. His placeholder is always a goo of some sort that is on the right of the two enemies in this room. He drops the {{:Two Handed Practice Sword}}, {{:Bone Chips (Golin's)}} and {{:Grave Sandals}}. <br><br>

'''"Carpet Goo"''' spawns in the room adjacent to "Thorny Goo" with a fire pit and carpet, hence his name. His loot table includes the various skulls, {{:Worm-eaten Gloves}} and {{:Fighting Baton}}. Carpet Goo is not limited to goos for his placeholders, so kill all the enemies in this room until you can identify exactly which of the spawns is acting as his placeholder.
